scope: Bounded 64-token prefill, public GPU-resident ORT bindings, pruned Qwen3.8-27B INT4/group32; target-only, not GenAI Engine MTP or WebGPU.
interpretation: Full 1K-input/256-output median warm TTFT improved 7836.313 -> 7432.907 ms (5.15% reduction). The reversed-order 32-token screen showed 1.56% lower median TTFT. The full control's increasing TTFT samples limit attribution of its entire median difference to the kernel. Short reversed samples are supporting diagnostics, not standalone decode throughput evidence. Decode routing below 32 packed tokens is unchanged; no decode speedup is attributed to this kernel. All full and reversed runs match the independent GenAI target-only reference. The original CPU-visible MTP trial did not improve and remains separately documented; no MTP or WebGPU lead is claimed.

runtime_identity.full_report_note: The old public runner recorded importlib.metadata.version, so its raw full reports say 1.31.1 despite the explicitly loaded isolated 1.32.0 runtime. The import/distribution mismatch was verified in the same PYTHONPATH environment and corrected before the reversed screen; both fields are now recorded. This is not a runtime change between modes.
